title.tr: Gri Boyalı Askılı Banyo Dolabı ve Mermer Tezgah
title.en: Grey Painted Wall-Hung Vanity with Marble Top

alt.tr: Gri metro fayanslı banyoda, mermer tezgahlı ve iki lavabolu gri boyalı askılı dolap; üstünde çerçeveli geniş ayna
alt.en: Grey painted wall-hung vanity with two sinks and a marble top in a tiled bathroom, with a large framed mirror above

caption.tr: İki çekmeceli, krom kulplu gri boyalı askılı banyo dolabı. Üzerinde beyaz damarlı mermer tezgah ve çift lavabo yer alıyor.
caption.en: Grey painted wall-hung bathroom vanity with two drawers and chrome handles, topped with a white-veined marble counter and double sink.
